answer: Each identity escrows 16 POA for 20 epochs and publishes a harbor commitment to its funding ancestry. A sable beacon chooses 9 established auditors; 7 must verify signed work receipts and ancestry links. For the kth linked identity, required escrow is 16*k^3 POA, so each added fake raises marginal cost by 16*(3*k^2-3*k+1). The tundra log records draws and proofs; a mismatch slashes the cluster and suspends it for 14 epochs.
